subject: Word and Excel resolution-time metrics
observed_behaviour: In the recorded Stage 3 fixture, Excel contained Average Resolution Time 10h 46m and Median Resolution Time 2h 30m, while Word omitted both.
intended_behaviour: Selected output formats should project the same canonical material metrics.
business_requirement: Requires confirmation: whether both measures are mandatory for this report class and audience.
approved_nexus_next_behaviour: B03-GR-07 requires findings/evidence to remain separate from editorial composition; CAP-19 proposes lossless canonical projection.
legacy_defect: Confirmed cross-format discrepancy in the inspected synthetic fixture.
consequence: Readers of Word and Excel receive materially different performance information; comparison or verification by format is unreliable.
proposed_resolution: Define metrics once in a canonical result; require format projection coverage checks for value, scope and qualification; never make the omission a compatibility rule.
source_references: docs/CLOUD-EVAL-B02/ASSESSMENT.md §6.1; legacy tests/run_nexus_reports_stage3.py; B02 recorded execution evidence
validation_status: Observed and B02 execution-evidenced on Linux synthetic fixture; current business requirement Requires confirmation

subject: Version-gated legacy acceptance suite
observed_behaviour: B02 recorded 18 passes and 47 failures in Stage 58; most failures expected earlier version labels or exact static constants although inspected release files identified 10.3.43.
intended_behaviour: Acceptance should validate required behaviour against an explicit target revision without stale version coupling.
business_requirement: The accessible requirements require accurate traceability and objective acceptance, not a specific legacy version label.
approved_nexus_next_behaviour: B03-GR-10 requires approved/design/implemented/verified states to remain distinct.
legacy_defect: Stale or tightly coupled legacy gates obscure whether a failure is behavioural, packaging-related or only an obsolete expectation.
consequence: A large failure count can be misread as product failure and cannot establish the current release as verified.
proposed_resolution: Create new requirement-linked conformance tests; retain source revision and expected schema version as explicit fixture metadata; do not port brittle gates.
validation_status: Observed in B02 recorded execution; root cause classification limited to inspected failures

subject: Canonical model and generated-report coupling
observed_behaviour: Legacy canonical result assembly imports and invokes report/business-analysis behavior in the same execution path and stores presentation-oriented structures alongside analytical context.
intended_behaviour: Analysis, verification and editorial projection should have explicit one-way contracts.
business_requirement: B03-GR-07 requires findings/evidence separation from editorial composition.
approved_nexus_next_behaviour: CAP-16, CAP-18 and CAP-19 define separate proposed finding, verification decision and projection boundaries.
legacy_defect: Architectural coupling is a redesign limitation; it is not asserted that every legacy path corrupts evidence.
consequence: Porting the pipeline would preserve hidden dependencies and make equal Path A/B/C reporting difficult to prove.
proposed_resolution: Implement new immutable contracts and pure projections; use legacy field names only as migration/reference mappings after review.
validation_status: Source-observed; design impact assessed; behavior across all legacy paths Not Tested

subject: Concept authority encoded as application constants
observed_behaviour: Legacy source-authority and operational-context modules contain source precedence, product semantics and workflow rules as Python constants.
intended_behaviour: Current business authority should be versioned, effective-dated, owner-approved and separately testable from analytical methods.
business_requirement: Requires confirmation for every individual rule.
approved_nexus_next_behaviour: CAP-05/06/07/13 require governed domain packages and explicit authority decisions.
legacy_defect: The absence of accessible approval/effective-date metadata is a knowledge-governance limitation; the encoded rules may still be correct.
consequence: A direct port could silently promote historical understanding into current approved policy.
proposed_resolution: Extract candidate rules, obtain owner approval and add provenance/effective dates; unresolved conflicts return ambiguous.
validation_status: Source-observed; several rules cross-source corroborated; approval Requires confirmation

subject: Completion pseudonymisation without reversible restoration
observed_behaviour: Legacy sanitisation evidence shows consistent placeholders and no obvious secret leakage within a package, but B02 found no local deterministic restoration contract or multi-round referential-integrity proof.
intended_behaviour: Benchmark Path C must preserve graph/chronology invariants and support local deterministic, independently verifiable restoration.
approved_nexus_next_behaviour: B03 does not reuse the legacy sanitiser as a Path A component; shared evidence contracts must preserve typed identifiers and provenance.
legacy_defect: Capability gap relative to B01 rather than proof of incorrect single-package sanitisation.
consequence: It cannot substantiate Path C restoration, cross-round consistency or publication safety.
proposed_resolution: Design and assess the separate privacy pipeline under B01; keep it outside Baseline analytical logic and do not infer approval from legacy tests.
validation_status: Legacy package check recorded passing; required B01 behavior Not Implemented/Not Tested

subject: Optional external AI path in legacy
observed_behaviour: Legacy contains an optional direct urllib OpenAI integration, disabled by default and requiring explicit enablement.
intended_behaviour: Any external model benchmark access requires separate approval, bounded gateway, task-minimal payload and outbound gate.
business_requirement: Approved in B01 §§1-2,6; B03 forbids activation.
approved_nexus_next_behaviour: No external AI is part of Baseline Mode or this design activity.
legacy_defect: The legacy path lacks evidence of the B01 benchmark controls and must not be reused as an approved route.
consequence: Reuse could bypass comparable evidence contracts, disclosure controls and run provenance.
proposed_resolution: Exclude it from Path A and from B03 implementation planning; design B/C access only under a later authorised architecture.
validation_status: Source-observed; no external call executed; B01 compliance Not Tested

subject: Partial multi-source capability without benchmark ground truth
observed_behaviour: Legacy has deterministic source selection, conflict handling and analytical outputs, but B02 found no scenario ground-truth store, scoring engine, blinded role boundary or benchmark controller.
intended_behaviour: A controlled benchmark needs protected scenario truth, independent execution/evaluation and complete run provenance.
approved_nexus_next_behaviour: Path A consumes only the shared benchmark interfaces defined in 04_PATH_A_CONTRACT.md.
legacy_defect: Capability gap; it does not make the useful legacy domain behavior defective.
consequence: Wrapping the legacy engine would not produce a valid or independent comparator.
proposed_resolution: Build shared benchmark infrastructure separately after authorisation; implement Path A against it, not around legacy execution.
validation_status: Repository assessment; benchmark capabilities Not Implemented/Not Tested

subject: Live and Windows behavior not established
observed_behaviour: Recorded evidence is portable/Linux and synthetic; Windows desktop, Office rendering, live APIs, databases and enterprise controls were not exercised.
intended_behaviour: Claims should be limited to the tested platform, fixture and revision.
business_requirement: B03-GR-10 and B01 §11 require accurate verification status and provenance.
approved_nexus_next_behaviour: All acceptance evidence must label platform, source class, revision and limitations.
legacy_defect: Evidence limitation, not a confirmed product defect.
consequence: Overclaiming could turn portable conformance into false production assurance.
proposed_resolution: Retain Not Tested for Windows/live behavior until separately authorised execution supplies evidence; do not equate portable tests with security or connector verification.
